Honedge

Steel Ghost

Kalos · Generation 6

Honedge is a Steel/Ghost-type Sword Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 2 kg. It evolves into Doublade. Its highest base stat is Defense (100), with a base stat total of 325.
